messages:
sam_sales: Morning team — Quick ask for Atlas POC: hosted API key with 10-day life, rotate at day 5, IP allowlist for 198.51.100.0/24 (their office). Need audit logging + a fast revoke path if security flags anything. Demo on Friday.

rita_se: Do they want an ephemeral one-time key or a workspace-scoped key we can revoke? Ephemeral avoids long-lived creds but harder to hand off during live demos.

sam_sales: They prefer ephemeral but want us to ensure demo won't break if rotation happens. Could we issue ephemeral with an automated renew before the demo?

carol_sec: From security: enable request-level audit logs, redact prompt/response bodies, and set retention 60 days for POC. Also we need an internal approval ticket before creating keys for enterprise customers. Is that in place?

tom_ops: Approval ticket present for Atlas (INC-2026-459). Ops can create an ephemeral key bound to their workspace and IP. We can schedule a rotation at day 5 and a pre-demo grace renew at T-2h. We can also add a revoke webhook to notify #sales and the approver.

rita_se: Implementation notes: name key like atlas-poc-sales-YYMMDD, tag owner=sam_sales. We'll attach metadata for audit: project=atlas-poc, contact=sam_sales.

sam_sales: Nice. Please also add a short revoke playbook I can forward to the customer: steps we will follow and expected time to revoke (max 2 min).

carol_sec: Revocation playbook: 1) Ops revoke via portal or CLI -> immediate token invalidation. 2) Revoke event posts to webhook + #sales. 3) Audit log entry created (policy, user, reason). 4) Ops confirm customer stops calls and we close ticket. 5) If customer needs reissue, require re-approval.

tom_ops: I'll create the key now. CLI we use internally (ops only):

```
# ops only
redwoodctl keys create \
  --name atlas-poc-sales-240123 \
  --owner sam_sales \
  --workspace atlas-poc \
  --ttl 10d \
  --rotate-after 5d \
  --pre-demo-renew 2h \
  --allowlist 198.51.100.0/24 \
  --redact-logs true \
  --audit-retention 60d \
  --notify-webhook https://hooks.redwood.sales/atlas-poc/revoke
```

opsbot: Created key: key_ATLAS789xyz (expires 2026-03-31T09:10:00Z). Rotation scheduled in 5 days. Pre-demo renewal at 2026-03-27T07:00:00Z. Audit logging enabled.

rita_se: Sam — I'll DM you the key via secure channel. Do not paste into customer Slack/email. Reminder: if their demo uses a different network the allowlist will block calls.

sam_sales: Understood. If their office tests from VPN, expect failures — will tell them to test from the listed CIDR.

carol_sec: Also, if the security questionnaire returns a blocker, we will perform immediate revoke and record the reason in the ticket. Ops will run the revoke command: `redwoodctl keys revoke key_ATLAS789xyz --reason "sq_blocker"`. Notify #sales and the approver.

tom_ops: Done. Ticket updated and automation added: if ticket state -> blocked, system triggers revoke and posts to channel.

sam_sales: Great — thanks. Forwarding to Atlas now and will report back after their pre-demo smoke test. :thumbsup:
